networkAccess.reasoning: Local development plugin. It connects only to a loopback-only bridge server (localhost:45677) running on this same machine, to send node-creation commands (frames / text / rectangles) into the Figma canvas. No data leaves the machine and no remote host is contacted. Note: Figma's manifest validator rejects the equivalent 127.0.0.1 spelling, so only the localhost form is listed.
